Name: Prowler.CAR.Scavenger
Description: Apex Prowler reactive skin (Scavenger, full evolution) on the CAR: native Prowler first-person animations, coil drum that turns with every shot, emissive coils and the full-auto Prowler fire sound. Minimal weapon script pins stock model paths and the stock sound routing; crosshair/FOV/ADS/UI and gameplay inherit stock values.

ConVars.Name: prowler_car_fx
ConVars.HelpString: Electric crackle on the Prowler CAR coils while firing
